market.what: formaldehyde scavengers added to UF-bonded wood panels (PB, MDF, plywood), world
market.method: est.: 381 Mm3 panels x ~30% dosed x ~1.5 kg/m3 x ~$1/kg = ~$170M; report $1.93B (2022) covers all uses (textile, coatings), not cross-checked

value.logic: E05/E0 raise resin cost 15-25% (~$13/m3 on ~$67/m3 UF resin); scavenger halves it: ~$6.5/m3 x ~100 Mm3 (EU 42 + China/export lines) = $650M (est.)
value.revenue_logic: 5 Mm3 boards/yr (~1.3% of world) x $3/m3 (0.5 kg/m3 x $6/kg)
value.margin_logic: specialty additive vs cheap urea/bisulfite; resin houses squeeze price

trend.drivers: EU REACH E05 0.062 mg/m3 from 6 Aug 2026; China GB 18580-2025 E0 mandatory from 1 Jun 2026; CARB2/TSCA VI; panel output +1%/yr
trend.deadline: EU REACH Annex XVII entry 77: 0.062 mg/m3 from 6 Aug 2026

indirect_startups: BindEthics (UK; formaldehyde-free bio adhesive, scaling to 2,000 L)
competition.notes: Resin majors own the market; NAF binders (pMDI, lignin) are main rival path.

lab.synth: catalog or 1-2 step custom small molecule, 3 variants; s0 not set yet
lab.test: lab-pressed 3-layer UF particleboard at 3 doses; EN ISO 12460-5 perforator + EN 717-3 flask, then EN 717-1/EN 16516 chamber (28 d); IB EN 319, swell EN 317; e.g. Fraunhofer WKI
lab.logic: synth 5 wk ~$15k; tests 8 wk: board pressing ~$10k + emission/mech ~$12k (est.)

sale.gates: mill line trial (strength, press time), third-party emission cert (CARB TPC / EN 16516 / GB) 6-12 mo, resin-supplier qualification
